title: Sufficient Context: A New Lens on Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
read_scope: §3 definition and autorater; §5.1 selective generation; §5.2 and conclusion/limitations; Table1 and Fig4 caption. PDF pp4–5,8–10. Other empirical sections/appendices not fully reread.
publication_evidence: ICLR 2025 official proceedings PDF; header confirms publication. Historical catalog lists 2024 arXiv first submission, not publication year.
research_question: Does context provide a plausible answer, independently of a generated candidate answer, and can this signal improve selective generation?
method: Query-context autorater; Gemini1.5 Pro for analysis, FLAMe for selective generation. Logistic regression combines binary sufficiency and self-rated probability, with100 hyperparameter-search iterations. P(True) uses20 sampled responses and5 judgments; P(Correct) is used for proprietary models.
data_and_controls: Autorater gold set115 query-context instances sampled from PopQA,FreshQA,NQ,EntityQuestions. Selective-generation plots use HotpotQA andMuSiQue. The115-instance label test is not the final QA evaluation size.
author_reported_results: Table1 Gemini1.5Pro one-shot accuracy .930 andF1 .935 on115 labels. §5.1 reports >5-point gain near70% coverage forGemini/HotpotQA. Fig4 caption: Gemma27B/MuSiQue sufficiency coefficient is0, curves identical.
metric_definitions: Sufficiency-label classification accuracy differs from selective answer accuracy. A sufficient context may contain an incorrect answer. Paper hallucination category is incorrect answer, not RAGChecker unsupported-incorrect claim metric.
critical_limits: Small gold label set; autoreader language/domain transfer unverified here; FLAMe labels context sufficient if any1600-token chunk is sufficient, potentially missing support spread across chunks. Exact split/leakage controls for logistic fit not established by this targeted read. Cannot copy correctness-oriented policy into strict source-only answering without redefining objective.
relation_to_project: Direct prior work for combining sufficiency and confidence; establishes that correct answers can arise from insufficient context but does not make them properly attributed.

title: Ground Every Sentence: Improving Retrieval-Augmented LLMs with Interleaved Reference-Claim Generation
read_scope: §§3.2–3.5;§4.2 andTables2–4;§4.6;§5 andLimitations;AppendixC.3 metric definitions. PDFpp3–9,14–15. Other appendices not fully read.
publication_evidence: Findings of NAACL2025 official ACL PDF; DOI10.18653/v1/2025.findings-naacl.55.
research_question: Can generating an exact reference before each answer claim improve fine-grained attribution?
method: Training data reference-claim pairs with NLI filtering threshold .8. Unified model contrasted with separate ReferModel andClaimModel; ClaimModel sees earlier references/claims without the full input context. Prefix-tree constrained decoding keeps reference text among supplied source sentences.
data_and_controls: TrainingTable1 four subsets4582,2605,3383,2653 rows; provenance WebGLM-QA/ELI5, not assumed independent new studies. EvaluationASQA,ELI5,EXPERTQA; selected/reranked anddefault retrieval settings must remain distinct.
author_reported_results: Table2 sameLlama3-8B: ALCE→ReClaimIG ASQA CAS54.7→92.1,EM-recall55.2→53.5;ELI5 CAS42.8→89.9,claim-recall20.5→17.8;EXPERTQA CAS51.4→90.1,claim-recall20.2→14.0. UnifiedASQA CAS68.2,belowIG92.1. These are author comparisons,not controlled causal estimates of interleaving alone.
metric_definitions: CAS corresponds toALCE citation recall over supported answer clauses. CRS adapts precision at sentence citation granularity. CR measures exact reference consistency; AR is proportion of answer sentences with attribution. RAGAS global-context faithfulness is supplementary and not causal faithfulness.
critical_limits: Exact source copying guarantees reference membership,not claim entailment; CR100% coexists withCAS<100%. Citation gains can coexist with answer-coverage loss. Multi-source/multi-hop capability not specifically trained; explicit quote output increases length/latency. No independent human claim-support validation established by the read sections.
relation_to_project: Sentence-level evidence-first generation is prior work. Must distinguish structural citation validity, source entailment and answer completeness.

title: RAGChecker: A Fine-grained Framework for Diagnosing Retrieval-Augmented Generation
read_scope: §3 framework/metrics;§4.2 human meta-evaluation andTable2;AppendixC annotation design;AppendixH limitations. PDFpp3–7,16–17,22. Other system-result tables not fully reread.
publication_evidence: NeurIPS2024 Datasets andBenchmarks official PDF; published source already in catalog.
research_question: Which claim-level retrieval and generation diagnostics align with human preferences?
method: Extract claims and check entailment against ground-truth answer andretrieved chunks; report overall precision/recall/F1,claim recall,context precision,faithfulness,noise sensitivity,self-knowledge andcontext utilization.
data_and_controls: Benchmark4162 questions in10 domains; meta-evaluation280 response pairs from8 systems,each judged by2 of10 annotators. AppendixC says annotators seeGPT-4-generated critiques. Long-form gold answers forsome datasets generated withGPT-4.
author_reported_results: Table2 overall Pearson .6193/Spearman .6090 vsRAGASAnswerSimilarity .4831/.5723. Not best in everycell: completenessSpearman .5811 vsRAGAS .6135. Humanoverall correlation .7009/.6889. Correlation is not per-claim checker accuracy.
metric_definitions: Faithfulness checks support anywhere inretrieved chunks,not the attached citation. Correct unsupported claims categorized self-knowledge; incorrect unsupportedclaims hallucination. Incorrect source-supportedclaims noise sensitivity. Entailment-only measures do not establish actual causal source use.
critical_limits: AppendixH explicitly mergesNeutral andContradiction asnon-entailment; Englishtext-onlybenchmark. Humanpreferences aided byGPT-4critiques,not fully unaided/blinded claim-level gold. Incomplete groundtruth can cause valid extra facts toappearincorrect. Model-based extraction/entailment errors propagate.
relation_to_project: Provides an evaluation/diagnosis framework,not byitself a generation-time verifier or calibrated answerability policy. Need citation-specific andcontradiction distinctions beyonddefault outputs.

title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
read_scope: §2 dataset setup;§3 correctness/citation metrics andshortcutcases;§6 human assessment;Tables8–9;Limitations. PDFpp2–5,8–10. Modeling/grid/other appendices not fully reread.
research_question: How should long-form QA with citations be assessed beyond answer fluency or factual overlap?
method: Measure fluency,correctness andcitationquality separately. Citationrecall checks statement entailment by concatenated cited passages. Citationprecision removes irrelevantcitations but doesnot demand a minimal evidence set; fulljointsupport is a prerequisite.
data_and_controls: 1000 development examples each fromASQA,QAMPARI,ELI5; Wikipedia/Sphere corpus passages100words. Human validation ofselected modeloutputs onASQA/ELI5,not a Vietnamese annotation study.
author_reported_results: Human-vsautomatic Cohen kappa .698 citationrecall and .525 precision; human-gold classifieraccuracy85.1%/77.6%. ASQArerankTable8 humanrecall79.3 vsautomatic83.9 demonstratesmetric-improvement gap. These numbers are validitychecks,not modelanswer accuracy.
metric_definitions: Citationrecall denominator outputstatements; correctnessrecall denominator requiredgoldanswers/claims. Citationprecision denominator attachedcitations,not allretrievedpassages. Citationrecall andprecision do notproveactual causaluse.
critical_limits: TRUE NLI imperfect,especiallypartial support. ELI5 generatedgoldclaims incomplete; MAUVE sensitive tolength/style. Simply copyingpassages can scorewell forcitation butpoorly forcorrectness/utility. Source reliability andabstention calibration notestablished bythesemetrics.
relation_to_project: Foundational directpriorwork forsource-specific support andcombinedcorrectness/citationevaluation. Jointsource entailment shouldnot be replaced byrequiringeverysource independentlyprovewholeclaim.
